name: Sickle
overview: The sickle in Scripture is primarily presented as an agricultural tool used for harvesting grain, as seen in Deuteronomy 23:25 where it is restricted to protect a neighbor's standing corn. Beyond its literal use, the sickle serves a powerful figurative role representing the judgments of God, particularly in the context of divine harvest and reaping of judgment, as depicted in Joel 3:13, Mark 4:29, and Revelation 14:14-15. These passages emphasize the certainty and urgency of God's righteous judgment, symbolized by the sickle wielded by the Son of Man to reap the earth at the appointed time.
